module: Lighting quality presets, consumed by graphicsQualityGroup. Each level sets the light manager, shadow filtering, specular, normal mapping, parallax, true water reflections and the shader quality group, via $pref::* keys. The onApply hook changes the active light manager.
notes: There is no Normal level in this module (only Lowest, Low, High, Ultra).
Only Lowest uses Basic Lighting; Low uses Advanced Lighting; High and Ultra use Advanced Lighting 1.5 with exactly the same values (Ultra is identical to High).

qualityLevels.desc: Levels Lowest, Low, High, Ultra. Keys: $pref::lightManager, $pref::Shadows::filterMode, $pref::Video::disablePixSpecular, $pref::Video::disableNormalmapping, $pref::Video::disableParallaxMapping, $pref::Water::disableTrueReflections, $pref::Video::ShaderQualityGroup.

onApply.desc: Called by graphicsQualityGroup when a value has changed. Reads $pref::lightManager; if getActiveLightManager() is already equal, does nothing, otherwise calls setLightManager.
